title: three-way-budget-slice-optimizer-hc-shift-scenarios
content:
Purpose: quick working workbook for a three-slice budget + HC reallocation experiment. We want a compact set of actions and triggers that can be executed in <30 days if market shows pricing pressure or volume shifts. Meant to be operated by Finance + GTM + Eng leads (small war room).

Executive summary:
- Create three budget slices: conserve, baseline, grow. Each slice maps to specific hiring posture, pricing moves, and capacity mix (hosted vs dedicated).
- Primary lever is pricing-floor adjustment combined with targeted HC shifts from new product to throughput/reliability (short-term).
- Decision triggers defined as 4-week rolling revenue delta and 90-day runway impact.

Assumptions (working):
1) Baseline token price (avg blended) = $0.018 / 1k tokens for Q4 2026 baseline.
2) Avg tokens per active workload = 250k tokens/month (median customer).
3) Variable infra cost per 1k tokens (blended GPU amortized + cloud) = $0.007 baseline, can drop to $0.005 with aggressive batching/quantization.
4) Sales & marketing CAC and ramp timelines unchanged across slices (we model as fixed for short-term transitions).
5) Hiring lead time: Eng/SRE 8–12 weeks, CS/AM 6–9 weeks.

Key metrics to watch (weekly): MRR, tokens/day, gross margin per token, committed Dedicated capacity utilization, burst reserve % used, average latency P50/P95 on top 10 routes.

Scenario tables (summary row format):
- Conservative (slice A) -- objective: protect runway
  - Pricing: implement price floor (-8% blended) for new signups (to maintain ARR, accept margin compression)
  - HC: hiring freeze except critical SRE & infra (defer 14 FTE hires planned in Q1 -> postpone 9 hires, keep 5 critical)
  - Ops: shift 20% load to lower-cost regions, enable aggressive batching profile
  - Expected delta vs baseline: revenue -3% in 3 months, gross margin -6 p.p., runway +5 weeks

- Baseline (slice B) -- objective: steady-state
  - Pricing: no change; monitor price elasticity cohort by cohort
  - HC: proceed with planned 14 hires phased across Q1 as planned (mix: 6 Eng, 3 SRE, 2 Product, 3 CS)
  - Ops: moderate optimization (prefix caching rollout + KV cache policies)
  - Expected delta vs baseline: revenue 0%, gross margin 0 p.p., runway neutral

- Grow (slice C) -- objective: defend growth and exploit demand
  - Pricing: small price increase on advanced features (+4% blended on premium routes), credit program for high-volume accounts to preserve retention
  - HC: accelerate hires by +6 (bring contractors -> perm for 3 Eng roles and invest in growth AE hires)
  - Ops: invest in Dedicated capacity to improve latency and sell premium SLAs
  - Expected delta vs baseline: revenue +6% in 3 months, gross margin +3 p.p., runway -3 weeks (funded by commit)

Headcount plan snapshot (quarterly, headcount numbers are incremental hires):
Q1 2027 hires planned by slice (engineering-focused):
- Eng: slice A = +1 (critical), slice B = +6, slice C = +9
- SRE: slice A = +2, slice B = +3, slice C = +4
- Product: slice A = 0, slice B = +2, slice C = +3
- Sales/CS: slice A = +1 (critical enterprise), slice B = +3, slice C = +6
- Finance/Legal: slice A = 0, slice B = +0, slice C = +1

Simple headcount cost model (fully loaded monthly per hire):
- Eng = $25k/mo, SRE = $28k/mo, Product = $22k/mo, Sales/CS = $18k/mo, Finance = $16k/mo

Pricing sensitivity matrix (simplified):
Columns: Price change (-10%, -5%, 0%, +5%, +10%)
Rows: Volume change (-15%, -5%, 0%, +5%, +15%)
Cell = estimated % change to gross margin vs baseline after accounting for infra cost elasticity.
(Example snapshots):
- Price -5% & Volume -5% -> margin impact ~ -9 p.p.
- Price +5% & Volume -5% -> margin impact ~ -1 p.p. (volume loss offset by higher unit price)
- Price +10% & Volume +5% -> margin impact ~ +8 p.p.

Trigger rules (operational playbook):
1) Revenue band trigger: if 4-week rolling revenue < plan by > 5% -> Convene war room; within 7 days pick slice A or B.
2) Margin trigger: if blended gross margin drops > 4 p.p. vs plan for two consecutive weeks -> implement immediate infra throttles, enable batching flags, pause noncritical deploys.
3) Headcount trigger: if runway (cash + committed) < 24 weeks under current burn -> hiring freeze + pause contractor conversions.
4) Enterprise churn trigger: if top 25 customers' avg usage drops > 12% -> execute targeted credits and tiered pricing to prevent churn (hold price floor).

Operational actions by function (short list):
- Finance: run weekly updated sensitivity with actuals; produce a one-page slide for execs (template attached in Confluence).
- Eng/SRE: flag low-hanging batching/quantization on top 3 models; estimate P&L impact if we achieve 10% token-cost reduction.
- GTM: pause pricing experiments for new accounts until 2 weeks after any price move; prioritize renewals for accounts > $10k ARR.

Quick sensitivity worked example (baseline -> conservative):
- Baseline tokens/month = 9.5B total; baseline revenue = tokens/1k * $0.018 = $171k/mo (example scaled down per team bucket)
- If price floor -8% and volume -3% due to macro, effective revenue change = -10.3% -> delta to monthly revenue = -$17.6k (for this bucket).
- Infra ops target: recover 40% of delta via batching + region mix -> net loss reduces to -$10.5k.

Open questions / unknowns (TODOs):
- Need finer-grained price elasticity by cohort (enterprise vs startup vs partner) — ask Growth for cohort extraction: GROWTH-219.
- Precise cost uplift for Dedicated capacity ramp vs public cloud for Q1 uncertain (ask Infra to model 3 region mixes).
- Legal: confirm implications of changing SLA pricing for existing committed customers (ticket LEG-312).

Contingency execution checklist (if slice A selected):
- Day 0: Freeze noncritical hiring; message to leads (template: /templates/hiring-freeze-msg).
- Day 3: Turn on batching aggressive profile and enable model quantization flags for non-latency-critical routes.
- Day 7: Shift targeted traffic to lower-cost regions (list in infra-runbook).
- Day 14: Re-evaluate revenue & margin; either continue or revert partial settings.

KPIs for review cadence:
- Weekly: tokens/day, gross margin per token, 4-week rolling revenue delta, committed capacity utilization
- Biweekly: headcount hiring pipeline (offers, acceptances, start dates), CAC payback trend per cohort
- Monthly: runway delta, ARR net new, churn of top 50 customers

Communication plan (to ops + execs):
- If conservative slice enacted, finance to deliver short note + one-pager to Execs within 48 hours.
- For any price moves, legal + customer success must sign off on messaging and credits within 24 hours.

Bottom line / recommendation (working):
- Prepare to operate slice B by default; ready runbook for slice A to be executed within 72 hours if revenue delta exceeds -5% on rolling 4-week.
- Build a 2-week effort to quantify infra token-cost improvement (target: $0.005 / 1k tokens post-optimizations) — this is the single biggest lever to avoid painful HC cuts.

Notes / links / references:
- See Confluence: price-elasticity-study-2026 for cohort breakouts (linked above).
- Jira: FIN-4823 is the model that wires the weekly sensitivity; hold questions there.

Author notes: this is a lightweight operational workbook not final finance model. Will convert into formal deck if Execs ask.
